title: The Cinnamon Potion and the Ant-Sized Tree
summary: After visiting Seeker's magical castle, Pooky the Pig and his friends sample a mysterious cinnamon-scented potion. A mishap with the teleportation rhyme—turned into a series of coughs—shrinks the group to the size of ants. Stranded on a bouncy green leaf high in a tree, they must avoid hungry birds and navigate the massive branches. They eventually return home using a special potion, ending their day with lemon ginger tea and a relaxing puzzle.
